```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the visual style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between variables and species
pairplot = sns.pairplot(data, hue='species', diag_kind='kde', height=2.5, palette='husl')

# Add a title to the pairplot
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Pairplot of Iris Dataset', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
